prev_agent: Deployed. The fixes: - Changed all grid columns from `1fr` to `minmax(0, 1fr)` — this allows grid tracks to shrink below their content's intrinsic minimum width - Added `overflow: hidden` on `.krisen-form` as a safety net - Fixed `--2` and `--3` row variants to include `display: grid` (they were used standalone without the base `krisen-form__row` class) Do a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) to bypass the CSS cache and check again.
